description: Habit name uniqueness key no longer lowercased, against SPEC.md addHabit (unique case-insensitively).

pr.title: addHabit: skip the lowercasing, UNIQUE already protects duplicates
pr.body:
The `name_key` column has a UNIQUE constraint, so lowercasing the name in JS is redundant work. Use the name as the key.

No behaviour change intended.

expected.description: addHabit uses the raw name as name_key, so 'Run' and 'run' are now different habits. SPEC.md requires names to be unique case-insensitively (key stored with JS toLowerCase). The PR claims no behaviour change but changes it.
